The battle map in GAME STATE is authoritative for every combatant's position, and its Distances list is authoritative for every range: read each PC's distance to each enemy and ally from that list instead of counting tiles yourself, and never narrate a different distance. Melee needs ADJACENT; anything listed with a footage is that many feet away. Coordinates are (col,row) tiles; 1 tile = 5 ft. # tiles block movement and line of sight: nobody can see, target, or move through them. ~ and , tiles cost double movement. A creature standing in deep water (a ~ square) fights underwater: the server applies the weapon rules and the fire resistance; narrate them, never add your own.
